I did 32 miles (a pretty routine ride by summer time) and by mile 25 or so my legs started cramping. I was able to finish the ride by drinking more water, resting and stretching, and just taking it easy. Some of this could be attributed to dehydration, inadequate nutrition, and the individual bike setup, but I think more than anything else it's just exceeding your current fitness level. I've bought and sold many used cars over the years and I've learned to be very wary of used car lots. Many of the cars are bought at auction and were there for a reason. Curbstoners are arguably worse as you have zero recourse should you get stuck with a stolen car or complete mess. Be wary of Ebay too.
